observations.observed: PayPal AI Hackathon official rules checked 2026-10-05: submission period runs 2026-10-01 09:00 PT through 2026-11-12 12:00 PT; no purchase/payment necessary; age-of-majority individuals, teams, and organizations are generally eligible subject to listed geographic/sanctions/conflict exclusions. Projects must build or significantly update an application during the submission period, integrate the PayPal developer platform through its free sandbox, and use an AI tool/model/platform of the entrant's choice. Existing projects are allowed only if significantly updated after the submission period starts, with the update explained. A functional demo, public GitHub repository with visible open-source license, and public demonstration video under three minutes are required. Third-party SDK/API/data use must be authorized. Official cash awards include $12,000/$8,000/$5,000 grand prizes, five $5,000 honorable-mention prizes, and multiple sponsor cash/credit prizes; multiple-prize eligibility is constrained by the rules.
observations.entry_cost: No purchase or payment necessary under the official rules; PayPal sandbox access is described as free.
observations.deadline: 2026-11-12 12:00 Pacific Time for submission under the live official rules checked 2026-10-05.
observations.prize_evidence: Official rules list $12,000 / $8,000 / $5,000 grand prizes; five $5,000 honorable mentions; AG Grid cash prizes of $5,000, $2,000 and three $1,000 awards; three $1,000 APIMatic cash awards plus subscriptions; three $1,000 Bryntum awards; one $1,500 Channel3 award; and Render credit awards. Prize verification/forms/tax/payment terms apply.
observations.eligibility: Age-of-majority individuals, teams, and organizations are generally eligible, subject to listed geographic/sanctions prohibitions, promotion-entity/judge conflicts, and other official exclusions.
observations.authorization_scope: This is a software-build competition. The listing authorizes use of the PayPal developer sandbox and permitted sponsor tools under their terms; it does not authorize security testing of PayPal, Venmo, Braintree, other PayPal services, third-party systems, public hosts, or repositories. Third-party SDK/API/data use must independently satisfy applicable terms and licensing.
